name: RailDraw Signalling v1.4.0
releaseNotes:
• Streamlined Edit Mode: Clean, uncluttered UI with tabbed route, trench, and notes editors
• Liquid Glass Aesthetics: Fully rounded pill buttons, frosted glass cards, and smooth specular highlights
• Glitch-Free Update Engine: Rotating loading wheel with real APK download & installation support
• Enhanced CAD Canvas: High-precision interactive S&T symbol placement without visual noise
• Single-action back navigation and native gesture handling
